Qondisa ikhamera yangemuva kulokho ofuna kuchazwe. Ku-Khomba ufunde, khomba umbhalo osesithombeni sekhamera ngomunwe. Izincazelo zingaba yiphutha. Ungazethembi ukuze uhambe ngokuphephile.

Izigcawu, Khomba ufunde, Ukutholwa kwabantu kanye Nokutholwa kweminyango kuthumela isithombe sekhamera ku-Gemini API ka-Google njalo emizuzwaneni embalwa. Umbhalo ubonwa kule foni.\n\nNgokhiye we-API wamahhala, u-Google angagcina lokho akutholayo, akusebenzisele ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo yakhe, futhi akunikeze abantu ukuthi bakubuyekeze. I-AI ekhiqizayo isesesigabeni sokuhlolwa, ngakho-ke izokwenza amaphutha.
